text:
Process: independent execution unit with separate memory space and resources.

Thread: lightweight execution unit within a process, shares process memory and resources.

Key differences:

| Aspect | Process | Thread |
|---|---|---|
| Memory | Isolated | Shared |
| Creation cost | High | Low |
| Crash impact | Affects only itself | Can affect siblings |
| Context switch | Expensive | Cheap |
| IPC | Required | Shared memory |

Processes are heavier but safer. Threads are faster but riskier.
